quest.title: Thoughts Carried On the Wind
quest.description: The meteor shower out in the wild seems to have left Godwin all in a fluster...
quest.rewards_formatted: Fading Star's Might x20, Primogem x40, Mora x25000

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: I wonder how Glory is getting on...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's the matter?

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: Ah, it's you, Traveler. It's dangerous out here right now.

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: If you'd like to seek shelter somewhere safe, you should return to Mondstadt as soon as you can.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You're not heading back?

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: Well, I... I'm staying out here for now. I am a Knight of Favonius, after all — I cannot abandon my post at a moment like this.

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: I can't return to Mondstadt for various reasons, but I can still stay here and help out.

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: After the meteorites fell down, many monsters came under their influence, becoming exceedingly aggressive.

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: If left unchecked, they will definitely make huge trouble for us later. I was just getting ready to wipe them out, in fact.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Can you do it by yourself?

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: Uh, so they do have great numbers... But as long as I'm careful, I should be fine.

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: But if I were to go alone, who knows how long it would take to defeat them.

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: If you don't mind, Traveler, could you help me clear their camp out?

response.speaker: Godwin
response.text: Thank you, that would be a great help to me.

choices.text: Why not ask the Knights for help?

response.speaker: Godwin
response.text: Ask the Knights for— Well... Suffice it to say that I have my own private troubles.

response.speaker: Godwin
response.text: Please lend me a hand in destroying that monster camp. You may consider it as a favor done for the Knights as well.

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: Have you managed to wipe all the monsters out?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: All clear.

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: You have my thanks, Traveler. They should cease to be a threat for now.

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: You should head back to the city. I'm very sorry for asking you to risk yourself out in the wild while all this is happening.

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: When you're back in the city... could you help me take note of something?

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: I—It's a very simple matter! You just need to help me look out for it.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What might that be?

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: Well... When you're back in the city, can you help me see how Glory is doing?

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: She should still be safe in the city, but I can't help but worry.

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: So could you check in on her for me, please?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sure.

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: Thank you, Traveler. Oh, yes — could you also refrain from telling her that I'm here? Just... just tell her that I'm still on a mission in a faraway land.

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: I'm sorry, but I'm counting on you — you must tell her this. Again, my apologies, but I cannot share our private troubles with you.

dialogues.speaker: Glory
dialogues.text: I do hope Godwin is alright...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hey there. Godwin's asked me to check in on you.

dialogues.speaker: Glory
dialogues.text: Godwin? D—Do you know where he is? I haven't heard from him in a good long while, and I've been worried.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: He's still on a mission in a faraway land.

dialogues.speaker: Glory
dialogues.text: Oh... I see. Alright then.

dialogues.speaker: Glory
dialogues.text: If not for these meteorites, I would have asked after his whereabouts with the Knights...

dialogues.speaker: Glory
dialogues.text: I've been staying inside the city, so I've been safe so far. But he's probably still out there accomplishing his mission. If this phenomenon is occurring all over the world...

dialogues.speaker: Glory
dialogues.text: *sigh* I hope that he's alright.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: He will be.

dialogues.speaker: Glory
dialogues.text: Thank you. That would be wonderful. Oh, yes. Could you help me with something?

dialogues.speaker: Glory
dialogues.text: I purchased a set of Dandelion Seeds from Flora, and I was looking for someone to help me scatter them from a high vantage point... to let the wind carry them to Godwin.

dialogues.speaker: Glory
dialogues.text: But things being as they are, I don't think I'll be able to find someone who can help me at the moment.

dialogues.speaker: Glory
dialogues.text: Since you're here, could you help me bring these Dandelion Seeds to Godwin?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: No problem.

dialogues.speaker: Glory
dialogues.text: Thank you. He must be in a very faraway place right now. He did set out on that expedition with the Grand Master, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Glory
dialogues.text: Please take these Dandelion Seeds to him and tell him that I'm doing well. And then... remind him to take good care of himself.

talks.objective: Go to Mondstadt and look for Glory
Give the Dandelion Seeds to Godwin

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: Traveler, did you meet Glory?

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: How is she? Is she well? Was she injured? Is she— Well, yes, I know that she's been in the city this entire time, but still—!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: She sent you some Dandelion Seeds.

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: Dandelion Seeds... That's just like her. *sigh* I hope she's not angry with me.

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: Thank you for helping me this time as well. Please, take these.

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: *sigh* If only the Grand Master could return right now — this problem would be solved in no time at all.

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: Where in the world is the Grand Master... I wonder if he's received any word that something like this has happened?

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: *sigh* But even if he received the news, he wouldn't be able to return so soon, either...

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: *sigh* If only the Grand Master could return right now — this problem would be solved in no time at all.

dialogues.speaker: Glory
dialogues.text: I do hope Godwin is alright...
